GPTR-F-001-S154.title: Allowlist Schema and Request Contract Definition
GPTR-F-001-S154.description: Define and implement the strict allowlist schema and request contract for GPTReader requests, including permitted collections, fields, operators, and limits. Use Pydantic models to enforce validation at the boundary before enforcement logic executes.

GPTR-F-001-S155.title: Enforcement Audit Logging and Traceability
GPTR-F-001-S155.description: Implement structured audit logging for all GPTReader requests passing through enforcement, including accepted/rejected status, violation reasons, and sanitized query output. Ensure logs integrate with existing audit patterns and support SIT traceability.
